protocol.partitions: less/more held equity crossed with Nasdaq daily return above/below RF; equal/tied separately
protocol.intervals: non-overlapping intervals between either arm changing its held target; signal s affects first return s+2
protocol.ranking: top5 negative intervals per arm for descriptive concentration, never a signal or selection feature
protocol.notice: Diagnostic chosen after observing the adverse window. No new inference, parameter change, model selection or independent validation.
